question: (1)/(20) { is what percentage of } (10)/(90)?
solution:
**Given:**

 (1)/(20) { is what percentage of } (10)/(90)? 

**Formula Used:**

 {Percentage} = frac{{Part}}{{Whole}} times 100 

**Calculation:**

 Rightarrow (frac{1)/(20)}{(10)/(90)} times 100 

 Rightarrow (1)/(20) times (90)/(10) times 100 

 Rightarrow (90)/(200) times 100 

 Rightarrow (9)/(20) times 100 

 Rightarrow 45 

**∴ The correct answer is 45\% **
